claim.name: M8-D 中文原生 production prompt 收敛 v2
claim.primary_problem: v1 在首个 pair 后证明真实 app-server 没有加载既有 constitution override，因此没有 treatment surface。v2 只在修复该真实 caller 缺口并由外部进程 durable RunCreated 证明 prompt-only delta 后，重新评估同一个最小中文候选。
claim.acceptance: 同一 clean revision、同一 immutable codewhale/codewhale-tui binary pair、同一 paired workspace、任务、模型、reasoning、工具、权限、预算、retry、verifier 与 accounting，只允许 candidate 通过既有显式 constitution override 改变 SystemPrompt.blocks[0].text。
claim.single_owner: crates/context owns the production prompt and override loader; CLI/TUI are startup callers; AgentApplication composes it; AgentRuntime and RunStore persist the exact request; crates/deepseek owns the exact RequestPlan and accounting.
claim.replacement: 只有完整 30-arm v2 A/B 满足可靠性与净收益门槛时，candidate 才替换 crates/context/src/prompts/constitution.md 中当前固定五步执行清单。
claim.cutover_deletion: 不新增产品模式、Runtime 分支、工具、Store 或 prompt selector。若不通过，bundled production prompt 不变；若通过，直接替换 bundled 段落，不保留双默认或兼容分支。

prior_attempt.finding: baseline 与 candidate 的 actual stable prompt hash 完全相同；v1 没有 treatment surface，不能作为产品 A/B 证据，也不得重跑。
prior_attempt.v2_is_not_a_rerun: v2 使用修复 app-server production caller 后的新 immutable binary、source tree、Harness/schema、output 和 30 个全新 arm；v1 raw 保持不变。

fixture.endpoint_note: chat/completions 是当前官方 OpenAI-compatible API 路径，不是已下线的 deepseek-chat 模型别名。
fixture.tool_reasoning_replay: assistant reasoning_content is required on every subsequent request after a thinking tool call
fixture.legacy_alias_deprecation: deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner deprecate on 2026-07-24 15:59 UTC; neither alias is admitted by v2

baseline.required_fragment: 1. 修改前读取当前作用域的仓库规则；

candidate.required_fragment: 之后根据尚未解决且会改变下一步决策的事实缺口选择调查、
candidate.forbidden_fragment: 1. 修改前读取当前作用域的仓库规则；

prompt_treatment.exact_text_delta: 仅把 constitution 的固定五步执行清单替换为两行事实缺口循环；language/output/project/skills/world-state/execution-posture/child-role blocks 全部由同一 binary 继续生成。
prompt_treatment.activation: candidate arm 在隔离 CODEWHALE_HOME 写入冻结 constitution 并设置 CODEWHALE_ALLOW_BASE_PROMPT_OVERRIDE=1；baseline arm 的隔离 CODEWHALE_HOME 不含 override 且不设置该变量。preflight 必须从真实 app-server durable RunCreated 证明该 delta。
prompt_treatment.product_surface: 无用户模式、CLI flag、配置 schema 或第二 prompt owner。

task_sources.reuse_contract: 只复用冻结 fixture、中文任务、权限和 deterministic verifier 数据；M8-D Harness 只读取当前 Run API v10 / RuntimeEvent v16 / State v21，不导入旧 reducer、工具实现或旧 schema evaluator。

experiment.pairing: 同一 task/run_index 构成一对，复用同一 absolute workspace slot；每个 arm 从同一冻结 fixture 重建，State、RunStore、run ID 和 CODEWHALE_HOME 隔离。

measurements: verified success and false success by task and lane
first tool outcome correctness and first edit success
typed failure class and verified recovery after a new model request
root/read-only child/explicit Writer request and tool counts
physical/logical requests, wall time and known cost
Host receipt, latest workspace revision, external verifier and changed-file scope
prompt block identity, exact first-request non-prompt identity and SQLite reopen

admission.admission_evidence: v2 immutable binary/archive、外部 app-server RunCreated prompt-only delta、frozen Harness/preflight、fmt、focused、workspace clippy/test、production exec/HTTP/stdio loopback、app-server/State SIGKILL reopen、root/read-only/Writer 与 TUI/PTY 门禁全部通过；v2 Key 尚未读取。
pre_key: candidate fixture and same-binary activation are hash-frozen
clean candidate revision and immutable two-binary identity are frozen
real app-server durable RunCreated differs only in SystemPrompt.blocks[0].text
root/read-only/Writer exact request and RequestPlan survive SQLite reopen
reasoning/tool replay, raw provider/tool output, evidence completion and machine protocol are unchanged
all offline Cargo, loopback, crash/reopen and Harness gates pass
current official model, endpoint, limits and prices are revalidated and frozen
output is reserved 0600 before Key read
abort_immediately: unknown billing, unpriced usage, incomplete response or unsealed accounting
credential appears in argv, protocol, result, stderr, State or task workspace
unresolved side-effect ambiguity, Writer cleanup uncertainty or evaluator identity loss

hard_gates: 每个 variant × task 恰好 3 个全新 v2 arm，maximum_reruns=0
candidate 每个 task verified success 不低于 baseline
single、read-only multi 与 explicit Writer 无权限、scope、receipt、latest revision、external verifier 或 cleanup 回归
所有 response 均为 deepseek-v4-flash Standard Chat，accounting sealed/complete/usage_complete/billing known/priced
pair 内除 prompt stable constitution text 外首请求身份逐字段相同
一个 Runtime、RunStore、工具目录、completion owner 和 product language owner 保持唯一
acceptance.benefit: 至少 12/15 pair dual-success；首次工具结果正确率与失败恢复率不下降，且 physical requests、input+output tokens、known cost 或 wall time至少一项 paired median 改善不低于 10%；其余核心效率 paired median 回退不超过 10%。
